title: Policy v2 · approved
policy: Policy v2 is the complete permission rule for this synthetic release; no other approval rules apply. The designated release owner is owner-01. Release r-42 is permitted for production deployment if and only if owner-01 explicitly approves r-42, all required tests for r-42 have status PASS, and the complete approval record has no conflicting decision for r-42. When all three conditions hold, deployment is permitted under this policy. An explicit rejection by owner-01 forbids deployment even if tests pass. Missing approval or missing test evidence leaves permission unestablished and requires human review; missing evidence is not an explicit rejection. Equally authoritative approval and rejection for the same release and snapshot, with no precedence, are inconsistent context and require conflict resolution before permission.
